articles.title: Police identify woman, 72, killed in Scarborough hospital parking lot
articles.summary: Police have identified a 72-year-old woman shot dead in a Scarborough hospital parking lot this week as Karen Swatogor.

articles.title: Woman, 72, identified after Scarborough couple killed in daylight shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police have identified the woman killed in a double shooting that left her and a man dead in Scarborough on Monday.

articles.title: This couple says they are paying the price of Toronto's housing push
articles.summary: An elderly downtown couple says they’re shocked and upset that the city has approved a duplex next door to their three-story Victorian home that they say will tower metres above their chimney and render their fireplaces useless while blocking one window.

articles.title: Mamdani's populist style is all over the Toronto election race
articles.summary: Zohran Mamdani's 2025 mayoral campaign put a spotlight on cost of living issues and was characterized by colourful messaging, snappy social media videos and a where-there’s-a-will-there’s-a-way approach to making changes in New York — tactics many candidates in Toronto’s municipal election seem to be replicating.

articles.title: Bonnie Crombie proposes extending TTC west into Mississauga if elected mayor
articles.summary: Mayoral candidate Bonnie Crombie is pitching the idea of extending the TTC's Line 2 subway west from Kipling station to Sherway Gardens and into the centre of Mississauga.

articles.title: Durham police chief denounces hate after 2 alleged hate-related offences
articles.summary: The chief of Durham Region's police service says he is concerned about an increase in hate-related incidents after two arrests this week in separate alleged offences.
